purpose: Tradition-agnostic keyword mapping layer. This is the Rosetta Stone layer: one row, many translations.

meta.mapping_principle: Every entry below is a set of PARALLEL readings, not a hierarchy of correctness. No column is privileged over another. The 'Kabbalah' column is not more true than the 'Neuroscience' column — it is differently useful.
meta.invitation: Add your own column. The schema is designed to be extended, not completed.
meta.warning: If any single column starts being treated as ground truth, the Transcompiler has failed at its one job.

anger.Zen: Attachment to a self that feels threatened
anger.CBT: Cognitive distortion — often catastrophizing or should-statements
anger.Stoic: Judgment that an external event is a harm, when it is only an impression
anger.Recursive_Symbolics: Operator: Decision(x) where x = perceived_injustice; high-gain, low-latency operator

focus.Neuroscience: Prefrontal cortex engagement, reduced default-mode network activity
focus.Stoic: Attention restricted to what is 'up to us'

expansion.Stoic: Oikeiosis — the widening circle of concern
expansion.Recursive_Symbolics: Operator: Broadcast(x) — increases connection edges in the state graph

integration.Recursive_Symbolics: Operator: Converge(x) — minimizes Hₛ locally without collapsing variety to zero

groundedness.Stoic: The present moment as the only place action occurs
groundedness.Recursive_Symbolics: Operator: Instantiate(x) — collapses abstraction to a concrete state

confusion.Zen: Don't-know mind (can be generative OR distressing depending on context)
confusion.Neuroscience: Reduced signal-to-noise ratio in relevant neural circuits
confusion.Stoic: Assent withheld from all impressions — epoché without return
confusion.Recursive_Symbolics: Operator: Diverge(x) — Hₛ trending toward 1 with no attractor

extension_instructions.how_to_add_a_tradition: Add the tradition name to 'traditions_registered', then add a matching key to every entry in 'abstract_mapping'. Entries may be null if untranslated yet — null is honest; a forced mapping is not.
extension_instructions.how_to_add_a_concept: Add a new top-level key under 'abstract_mapping' with one sub-key per registered tradition.
